verdict.rationale: ImageMagick's own CLI can combine conversion and compression in a single invocation (e.g. PNG to WebP at quality 85), and it describes a scripting-first design for mass batch jobs. Beyond that, multi-step orchestration relies on user-written scripts, and there is no evidence of a delivery step or a watched-folder workflow. Missing for 10: documented delivery/upload step, watched-folder or trigger-based workflows, native job/pipeline definitions beyond single-command operator chaining, independent corroboration of chained pipelines.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can chain steps (convert, then optimize, then deliver) into one job or watched workflow

citations.quote: # Convert PNG to WebP with compression $ magick input.png -quality 85 output.webp
CLI & Automation Scripting-first design for mass batch jobs.
